forensic_report.operating_leverage_analysis: Meta operates a highly scalable digital advertising model with massive fixed costs (data centers, R&D, AI infrastructure) and near-zero variable costs for serving additional users or ads. This results in historically high gross margins and significant operating leverage.
forensic_report.moat_evidence: Meta's primary moat is its unparalleled network effect across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, boasting over 3 billion daily active people. Advertisers are forced to use Meta due to its massive, highly engaged audience. The social graph creates significant switching costs for users.
forensic_report.pricing_power_evidence: Meta uses an auction-based model for ad inventory. As algorithmic targeting improves (e.g., Advantage+), ROI for advertisers increases, allowing Meta to naturally command higher CPMs and drive up Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) without losing advertiser demand.
forensic_report.concentration_details: Meta has a highly diversified revenue base with millions of active advertisers, ranging from SMBs to large enterprises. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of total revenue.

value_chain_report.bottleneck_analysis: Meta faces critical upstream bottlenecks from mobile operating system gatekeepers (Apple iOS and Google Android), which control user data access and distribution (e.g., Apple's App Tracking Transparency). Furthermore, Meta is heavily reliant on Nvidia GPUs for its massive AI infrastructure build-out, creating a hardware supplier bottleneck.

This forces advertisers to bid higher in the auction, effectively acting as strong pricing power and pass-through capability.
value_chain_report.analysis_summary: Meta holds immense strategic leverage due to the unparalleled network effects of its Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp). Despite facing upstream bottleneck risks from mobile OS providers (Apple) and AI hardware suppliers (Nvidia), as well as engagement competition from TikTok, Meta's AI-driven ad targeting maintains high advertiser lock-in and robust pricing power through its auction dynamics.
